Overview

Fiscora is a finance website and dashboard for small businesses. It is Avora Digital's own product: designed, built and run in-house, and live at getfiscora.com.

The challenge

Small business owners see their sales, not their real profit. Courier charges, returns, payment fees, ads and tax eat the margin, and nobody adds them up.

What we built

We built two layers. Free calculators answer one question each, in the visitor's language. The finance dashboard brings sales and costs together, so owners can see profit and loss, cash flow and profit by product, channel, city and courier, with alerts when something changes and planning tools to look ahead.

  • 20 free financial calculators in 10 languages, including Urdu and Arabic (right to left)
  • A finance dashboard: profit and loss, cash flow, expense analysis, receivables, profit by product, channel, city and courier, and alerts
  • Planning tools: a 3-scenario profit forecast, a 13-week cash forecast and budgets
  • Import from Shopify or any CSV file, an Orders API for custom websites, Excel export and a live Google Sheets link
  • 41 currencies with VAT, GST or sales tax; up to 3 businesses and a team of 3 per business
  • Privacy by design: Google sign-in, no customer contact details stored, and data deleted only when the user deletes it
  • Built with Next.js, Cloudflare Pages and Workers, and Cloudflare D1; payments through Paddle as merchant of record
  • Quality: 177 automated calculator tests, automated end-to-end tests of the dashboard, and every page checked in all 10 languages on phone and desktop

Status

Live at getfiscora.com. Payments through Paddle as merchant of record: checkout is being set up.
